entities.summary: Kiryat Malakhi also spelled Kiryat Malahi, Kiryat Malachi, or Qiryat Mal'akhi, is a city in the Southern District of Israel, 17 kilometres (11 mi) northeast of Ashkelon. In 2024 it had a population of 27,959. Its jurisdiction is 4,632 dunams (~4.6 km2).
